citation.authors: Polidori D, Sha S, Mudaliar S, Ciaraldi TP, Ghosh A, Vaccaro N, Farrell K, Rothenberg P, Henry RR
citation.title: Canagliflozin Lowers Postprandial Glucose and Insulin by Delaying Intestinal Glucose Absorption in Addition to Increasing Urinary Glucose Excretion

population.description: Healthy men: 20 enrolled, 19 completed both treatment periods, 1 withdrawn for noncompliance with study prohibitions (Results, first paragraph); fasting plasma glucose below 6.1 mmol/L at screening. n = 19 is the completers: the paper prints no n beside the areas ('Unless otherwise specified, all results shown are mean +/- SD'; the Abstract says 'in 20 healthy subjects'), so a placebo value from the withdrawn subject cannot be ruled out. Enrolment criteria (aged 18-45, BMI 20-27 kg/m2, weight at least 50 kg) are not observed ranges, so age and BMI are null. Table 1 (demographics) is an image in the XML and was not read.

protocols.name: placebo_mmtt
protocols.description: Matching placebo at arm minute 0 (paper t = -20 min, first blood sample), then a standard 600-kcal mixed-meal tolerance test at arm minute 20 (paper t = 0): liquid part 75 g glucose oral solution with 75 uCi 14C-glucose and 960 mg acetaminophen in 30 mL. Grams from the printed 600 kcal at 55% carbohydrate, 30% fat, 15% protein: carbs 600*0.55/4 = 82.5 g, fat 600*0.30/9 = 20.0 g, protein 600*0.15/4 = 22.5 g. Arm minute = paper clock + 20; blood at arm minutes 0,10,20,35,50,60,70,80,95,110,125,140,170,200,230,260,290,320,380 (paper t = -20 to 360 min). Start 08:00 assumed ('morning of day 1'). Fast: 'after an overnight fast of at least 8 h' the 3-h 3H-glucose infusion began (paper t = -180 min), so at the arm start (paper t = -20) the fast was at least 8 h + 2 h 40 min = 10.7 h; prefast_hours 11 is that lower bound rounded up, the paper gives no exact value. Baseline of the areas: 'the positive area above the premeal value', taken as the paper t = 0 sample (arm minute 20), the first of times. Acetaminophen is a gastric-emptying probe given in both arms and not entered; the 3H-glucose tracer is not an input.

left_out.what: Every value in the canagliflozin 300 mg arm and every canagliflozin-minus-placebo or ratio comparison (glucose and insulin areas, RaO, EGP, Rd, UGE, RTG, percent reductions; Results and Figs 1-3)

Placebo oral glucose appearance (RaO): AUC RaO 0-1, 0-2 and 0-6 h as geometric means 381, 723 and 1,018 mg/kg (Abstract; no dispersion) and maximum RaO 9.38 mg/kg/min (Results, LS geometric mean, no dispersion); the model has no series for this flux
Total oral glucose absorbed over 0-6 h, placebo 79 g (Fig. 2 legend, a calculated mean): no dispersion printed
Endogenous glucose production before the meal, placebo: 'approximately 2 mg/kg/min' (Results, Rates of EGP and Rd): an approximate value with no dispersion
Plasma acetaminophen AUC 0-2 h, placebo 10.29 ug h/mL (LS geometric mean, no dispersion; Results, Gastric emptying): a gastric-emptying probe, not a marker the model has
Incremental GIP area 0-2 h, placebo 63.5 +/- 20.2 pmol h/L (Results, Gut peptides): the GIP sampling minutes are 'predefined time points' that the paper does not print
Incremental PYY area 0-2 h, placebo 13.6 +/- 10.8 (Results, Gut peptides): the model has no PYY series; the paper prints no unit and no sampling minutes for it

Placebo time courses of plasma glucose, insulin, 14C and 3H tracer, oral RaO, glucose absorption (Fig. 1A-F), UGE, EGP, total and tissue Rd (Fig. 2A-D), and GIP, PYY, total and active GLP-1 (Fig. 3A-D): figure only
Subject demographics (Table 1): an image in the XML, not readable here
Placebo urinary glucose excretion 0-2 h and 2-6 h: only an upper bound ('less than 0.15 g in each interval', Results, UGE and RTG)
Total GLP-1 incremental area 0-2 h, placebo 10.1 +/- 5.38 (Results, Gut peptides): the paper prints no unit for this area and no sampling minutes
